speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked	the Minister for Manpower whether the Ministry will consider allowing Work Permit holders to engage in part-time work, considering Singapore's current labour shortage.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Many progressive companies have come forward to take up the LED scheme and we encourage more to do so.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I have asked whether we can consider allowing Work Permit holders to do part-time work but I understand this might already be happening on the ground, but under the radar.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: The reality is that workers want to work; companies need the workers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: These are jobs that they cannot find Singaporeans to work in, especially at that particular shift.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, rather than ban, can we consider regulating, so that we can protect the workers?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: As the Minister of State mentioned, if they are doing the part-time work under the radar, they might be exploited.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, if we are worried about opening the floodgates, then could I ask the Minister of State if they can consider opening up on a smaller scale, at perhaps a few industries or just one industry to start with, and study whether it works before deciding to ban or open it?

speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
text: The fundamental consideration is, firstly, to protect the interests of our local workers.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Minister of State Janil Puthucheary, I understand that you wish to make a clarification?
